# `sngl run` on html with a server language runs the server it generated, at
# the address `listen` names, rather than serving the directory holding
# server.go: a page whose href is a pattern is answered, which a static site
# cannot do.

serve run --platform html --lang go --opt listen=127.0.0.1:0 app.sngl
fetch $URL/
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'
stdout 'the home page'
! stdout 'server.go'
fetch $URL/p/x
stdout 'a pattern page'

-- app.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Pkg {
    name string
}

ui.window {
    nav.stack {
        nav.page #pattern(href=`/p/{name}`, title="Pattern", params=Pkg{name="x"}) {
            ui.text(value="a pattern page")
        }
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
            ui.text(value="the home page")
        }
    }
}
